title: Bundles
description: Bundles connect agents to outside tools: skills, MCP tools and rules. Pick them in an agent’s settings.

empty.title: No bundles
empty.description: Put a bundle directory in ~/.eta/bundles, or add one from git.

configure.title: Configure {{name}}
configure.secretPlaceholder: Set; leave empty to keep it
configure.encryptionHelp: Values are stored encrypted on this host and given only to {{name}}’s own processes. They never reach the agent’s shell and are not shown again.
configure.savedIncomplete: Saved; a required value is still missing
configure.clearConfirmDescription: Agents that use it lose its MCP tools and rules until it is set up again.

add.title: Add a bundle from git
add.hint: It is resolved to a commit and kept at it, so every install is the same files; use Update to move. Private repositories use this host’s git credentials.

remove.confirmDescription: Its files and settings are deleted from this host. Agents that load it lose it.

picker.help: Checked bundles give this agent’s sessions their skills, MCP tools and rules, from its next message.
picker.notConfigured: Not configured: only the skills apply
